intuition: The answer is the sum of the middle m - 2k values among the latest m stream elements.

brute_force.approach: Keep the latest m values, sort them for each query, and average the middle slice.
brute_force.time: addElement O(1), calculateMKAverage O(m log m)

optimal.approach: Maintain a sliding window plus Fenwick trees for value counts and value sums. Prefix order statistics recover the sums of the smallest k and smallest m-k values.
optimal.time: addElement O(log U), calculateMKAverage O(log U), where U = 100000

edge_cases: Return -1 until the window contains m elements.
Use integer floor division after removing both tails.
